title: Access grant
description: Abstract base of everything that confers access: a named, scoped, time-bounded subject of an authorization decision.

label.description: What an administrator sees in a list. Never parsed, never matched on.

scope.description: Whether the grant applies across the solution or inside one tenant.

tenant-id.description: The tenant a scoped grant is confined to. Required when scope is tenant.

effective-from.description: When the grant starts to confer access. Absent means since creation.

effective-to.description: When it stops. Revocation sets this rather than deleting the record.
